title: 若駒Sの後に・負けども夏は来る

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature gets a decent result in the Wakagoma Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, when she sees how Tokai Teio has captivated the crowd with her brilliant performance, she becomes discouraged.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest a trip to enter a local race, the Kokura Kinen, to give her more confidence.
